Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience) with proven administrative or HR support background.
Prior experience in higher education HR, specifically working directly with faculty or academic appointees.
Hands-on experience with specialized HR systems such as UCPath, AP Recruit, or equivalent academic personnel software.
Manage appointments, reappointments, merits, promotions, advancements, and onboarding/offboarding for academic appointees.
Prepare and review academic personnel dossiers for policy compliance (UC/UCI), accuracy, completeness, and maintain updated databases.
Oversee academic recruitment activities, manage documentation via AP Recruit, and track pending actions to meet deadlines.
Serve as a point of contact for faculty and department leadership on academic HR policies, procedures, and cross-office communications.
Extreme attention to detail with demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, meet strict deadlines, and handle confidential information.
Familiarity with UC and UCI academic personnel policies, procedures, and review standards.
Strong written and verbal communication skills paired with proficiency in Microsoft Office and capacity to learn university software systems.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
